name: Hurdle Jumping Game , by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
author: kelvinkit123
description: In this hurdle jumping game, you need to jump over the fence when you are running forward. By controlling it, please click on the "SPACE BAR" for jumping. And make sure the jumping time is very very important. If you hit the fence, its "Game Over" and you will be unconscious and lay on the ground. Please enjoy the game !! ^_^  , by Kelvinkit (Clever Games & Toys)
